note: Re-judged 2026-10-31 by an independent auditor who authored none of 6b0a55d9b9. RFC 2545 Section 3 read: "In all other cases a BGP speaker shall advertise to its peer in the Network Address field only the global IPv6 address of the next hop (the value of the Length of Network Address of Next Hop field shall be set to 16)." 6b0a55d9b9 changed only the RFC2545-3-1 comment of test/encode/new-v6.ci; the RFC2545-3-4 positive tag, the config (IBGP over 127.0.0.1, no link-local, next hop 2A02:B80:0:2::1 on no connected subnet, so the Section 3 condition does not hold) and both expect=bgp lines are byte-identical. The hex pins length 0x10 and exactly one 16-octet global before the Reserved octet, and attribute length 0x26 leaves no room for a second address. Producers read: buildMPReach appends a second address only when unicastLinkLocalNextHop(p) is valid, and normalizeOrdinaryNextHop (egress_inject_filter.go) keeps a 32-octet field only when scope.sharesNextHopSubnet(global) holds and otherwise rewrites the field to its first 16 octets. The recorded paired break (linkLocal forced to fe80::1 in buildMPReach together with the sharesNextHopSubnet test forced true in normalizeOrdinaryNextHop) goes red on this carrier, and each break alone stays green, which shows the egress normaliser itself enforces the all-other-cases branch on this rail. Its record's unit sha matches the current file and ./le rfc discriminate lists it as verified. The other carriers (TestRFC2545JointSubnetWriter, TestOrdinaryIPv6OwnGlobalJointSubnet, TestRFC2545ForwardPolicyOwnGlobalJointSubnet, rfc2545-joint-subnet.ci split-link, entity-off-link and recipient-off-link cases, conf-llnh-update.ci negative, TestSendAnnounceOmitsLinkLocalWhenPeerOffLink, TestDefaultOriginateOmitsLinkLocalWhenPeerOffLink) are byte-identical and their judgement stands; both halves (global only, length 16) are asserted. Ran ./le test bgp encode new-v6: PASS. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgements are in this file's git history.
